narrative:
Operating expenses of NOK 2,083M (30.7% of sales): store operations NOK 849M, rent and occupancy NOK 455M, marketing and e-commerce NOK 260M, logistics and the Gardermoen DC NOK 120M, and HQ, IT and administration NOK 399M.

External ERP, POS and BI consultants cost NOK 42M a year. The knowledge leaves with the consultants, which makes this the opex line most exposed to the data-platform decision.

signals.title: October close at WD+6 — September took WD+11 on Business Central
signals.source: SDP Month-End Close Control Tower — 12 close feeds, October 2026
signals.excerpt: September was the first close on Business Central: the BC API timed out under month-end volume and finance rebuilt the books from the Data Lake by hand over three days. October has 96.8% of records landed and 93.8% auto-matched on NOK 1,357M under close.
